title: Brazilian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Brazil, made with tender eggplant and a blend of spices. This dish is perfect for a cold evening and can be served with rice or bread. It's also gluten-free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: Hot peppers
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of hot pepper you like, such as jalapeno or habanero.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or canned tomatoes for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of onion you like, such as yellow or red.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: You can use more or less garlic depending on your personal taste.

ingredients.name: Stew meat
ingredients.notes: You can use beef, pork, or a combination of the two for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of cumin to taste.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of paprika to taste.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of salt to taste.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of black pepper to taste.

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and hot peppers to the pot. Cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Add the eggplant to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
